findings.suggested_fix: Translate the heading as 'कर्मचारी परिवर्तन:' or 'कर्मियों में परिवर्तन:' (preserving the colon) instead of 'कर्मकांड परिवर्तन:' which reads as 'ritual changes' and alters the intended meaning.
